examples.text: Ожидать можно было три судна, которые могли бы привезти товары: компанейский бриг «Константин», транспорты «Иртыш» и «Байкал».

glosses: разг. любящий компанию, подходящий для компании
Tending to socialize or be social.

examples.text: He's normally pretty quiet, but he gets much more sociable around women.
Society is no comfort to one not sociable.

glosses: Offering opportunities for conversation; characterized by much conversation.

examples.text: a sociable party

glosses: Capable of being, or fit to be, united in one body or company; associable.

examples.text: They are sociable parts united into one body.
Is the King sociable And bids thee live ?

glosses: A four-wheeled open carriage with seats facing each other.
A bicycle or tricycle for two persons side by side.
A couch with a curved S-shaped back.
An informal party or church meeting for purposes of socializing.

examples.text: At the church sociables he used to hop around among them, chipping and chirping like a dicky-bird picking up seed; and he was a great hand to play the piano, and sing saddish, sweetish songs to them.

glosses: Having the characteristics of a worthy companion; friendly and sociable.

examples.text: She returned presently, bringing a smoking basin and a basket of work; and, having placed the former on the hob, drew in her seat, evidently pleased to find me so companionable.
I love to be alone. I never found the companion that was so companionable as solitude.
All the disagreeable circumstances of my prison had become, as it were, to me friendly and companionable; not one of them gave me annoyance.
Then he strolled back again, kicking his heels carelessly, and a companionable silence fell between the three men.
They are a companionable food; they make a pleasant, crunching noise when they are bitten, and so, when one is eating carrots, one can listen to the sound of one's eating and make a story from it.
Bottles of rye, purgative waters and eaux for every conceivable toilette made a companionable click in his worn carpet bag.

The up and down lines ran next to each other in vault-like tunnels, whereas the Tube trains would occupy their own tunnels. That's why the cut-and-cover lines are more human than the Tubes. They are more companionable. You can see people going the other way - your perspective is broadened.

glosses: Que de modo natural entabla o mantiene relaciones sociales.

examples.text: Das war ein geselliger Abend.
„Er glänzte bei geselligen Anlässen gerne mit haarsträubenden Anekdoten und hatte schon bald den Ruf weg, ein vorzüglicher Erzähler und großartiger Spaßvogel zu sein.“
Er ist ein geselliger Typ und findet leicht Anschluss.
Stieglitze leben gesellig in kleinen Gruppen.

glosses: Qui est naturellement porté à rechercher la société, qui est destiné à vivre en société.

examples.text: Il essaya de se persuader qu’il était à l’aise et en sécurité ; mais bientôt, l’indéfinissable inquiétude de l’animal sociable, abandonné dans la solitude, le tourmenta.

glosses: Avec qui il est facile de vivre, qui est d’un bon et facile commerce.

examples.text: Cet enfant est sociable, il s’intègre facilement à l’école.
Le chien de prairie est un animal sociable.
Je le verrais quelquefois, s’il était plus sociable.

Madame Bergeret était précisément faite pour vivre en bonne intelligence avec un compagnon qu’elle trahissait et qu’elle opprimait dans la sereine exubérance de ses forces et dans le fonctionnement naturel de ses organes. Elle était sociable par richesse de chair et par défaut de vie intérieure.
C’est une chose étonnante comme je me sens sociable, comparé à lui.
Une humeur, un esprit sociable.
Un caractère sociable.
